{
    "content": "<p>If you're using an automated tool to create your user accounts and assign a Home\nFolder (a mapped drive pointing to shared location on a server) - make certain\nthat the property has a colon after the drive letter (e.g.\n<strong>Z:</strong> not <strong>Z</strong>). Without the colon, the drive will not be mapped on user log on. How do you know if this\nproperty is set correctly? Active Directory Users and Computers won't show you.</p>\n<p>Use <a href=\"http://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/bb963907.aspx\">ADExplorer</a>.\nThis tool will show you the properties, value types, and actual values of any\nobject in your Active Directory structure...very helpful for writing scripts and\napps that interface with LDAP.</p>\n",

        "rawInput": "\nIf you're using an automated tool to create your user accounts and assign a Home\nFolder (a mapped drive pointing to shared location on a server) - make certain\nthat the property has a colon after the drive letter (e.g.\n**Z:** not **Z**).
